thread:
Fiona: Quick FYI from the usability session — keyboard users get stuck when moving between the roles matrix and the invite drawer. The drawer opens but focus lands on the background list.
Greg: Oof. Is that the compact roles grid variant? We switched tabindex for performance.
Fiona: Yep, compact mode. It speeds render but breaks the focus order. Also testers misunderstood an inline SSO toggle inside the invite drawer 1 they thought it applied to org settings globally.
Helen: Can we separate the SSO toggle visually? Maybe move it under an 'Invitation options' header and add an inline helper: 'Applies only to invites sent after enabling'.
Ian: Agreed. For focus: when the drawer opens we should call `drawerEl.focus()` and set `aria-hidden=true` on the background. Minimal patch: trap focus inside drawer and restore focus on close.
Jacob: Backend note: the SSO config is per-org and per-invite flag is derived. We need to be careful with copy so we don't imply it's per-user.
Fiona: Mock posted: https://redwood-assets/mocks/invite-drawer-compact-fix.png  1 variant shows moved toggle + helper + clearer CTA.
Designbot: Uploaded prototype with keyboard flow (v3): https://redwood-assets/prototypes/invite-drawer-v3.html  1 includes aria-live region for confirmation message.
Greg: Accessibility nit: contrast of the helper link is 3.8:1 currently. Need >=4.5:1. Also ensure visible focus ring on the roles cells when tabbed.
Helen: UX copy suggestion: Replace 'Require SSO for invites' with 'Require SSO to accept invitations'. Shorter alt: 'Require SSO for accepting invites'.
Ian: Code snippet for focus trap idea:
```
drawer.addEventListener('open', () => {
  document.querySelector('#main').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  drawer.querySelector('[data-first]').focus();
});
```
Jacob: For audit logs: CS asked for a preset filter 'Invite events 1 SSO' that groups invite sends + SSO state changes. Should populate breadcrumb so you can deep-link to the filtered view.
Fiona: Yes, deep links are important. Maybe `/?filter=invites.sso:on` style so support can paste into tickets.
Greg: Analytics we should emit: `invite_drawer_open`, `invite_sso_changed`, `roles_grid_compact_mode_toggled`. Include `user_agent` to help debug keyboard runs.
Helen: Small accessibility test plan: e2e keyboard smoke test, screenreader run with JAWS/NVDA for the drawer flow, and color contrast checks for helper text. Add to the pre-merge checklist.
Jacob: I'll prep the audit filter backend mapping and a short DB migration note if we add a `sso_state` column to invite_events.
Fiona: Can someone pick up a tiny PR for copy + focus trap + contrast tweak? Assigning @Greg.
Greg: I'll open a PR today 1 will include unit+e2e tests and a note for the data team about the audit breadcrumb deep links. ETA: EOD.
Designbot: Reminder: design review at 2:30pm 1 will demo the prototype keyboard flow and the copy variants.
Fiona: Thanks all 1 I'll add the usability session notes to the review thread and ping support for deep link use cases. :thumbsup:
